about.heading: About me
paragraphs: Hi, my name is Melissa Aguilera, and this is my website.

I am autistic with ADHD — a combination, not two separate things, and it shapes the way I learn. It means deep, sustained focus on what I care about, and a mind that rarely stops asking questions. I have stopped treating that as something to fix and started building a place where it works in my favour.
I love learning new things. That is the simplest and truest thing about me. Not collecting facts, but actually understanding how something works — and getting better at the craft of learning itself.

One of my main interests has always been learning languages. Russian is the one I am working on now, starting from the very beginning and doing it properly: Cyrillic, pronunciation, listening, and real reading rather than memorised phrases.

All of it lives here at cookieheaven.art, and most of it lives inside Professor Citachka — the university I am building for myself. Eleven subjects, written the way I actually need them: patient, precise, accessible, and never watered down. That project began as a way to study Russian and grew into something much larger, because one subject was never going to be enough.

The art, the photographs and the music on this page are here for the same reason. A mind like mine does not stay in one lane, and I would rather show the whole range than pretend it is narrower than it is.
If you are someone who never really stops learning either, you are welcome here.
